landing.heroTitle: Environmental monitoring for your server rooms
landing.heroSubtitle: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for continuous environmental monitoring of your server rooms. Multi-channel real-time alerts.
landing.featureRealTimeDesc: Async collector polling the STE2 gateway at configurable intervals. Live dashboard display via WebSocket push.
landing.featureMultiChannelDesc: WhatsApp, SMS and Email notifications when thresholds are exceeded. Anti-spam, anti-spike, deduplication built in.
landing.featureMultiTenantDesc: Strict per-company data isolation. One account = one company. No cross-tenant data leaks.
landing.featureRetentionDesc: 30-day data retention with automatic deletion by TimescaleDB. Built-in compression to save storage.
landing.featureSecurityDesc: JWT RS256, strict isolation, Pydantic validation, rate limiting, lockout, audit trail. Zero open ports via Cloudflare Tunnel.
landing.featureDashboardDesc: React 19, WebSocket push, Recharts graphs. Dark mode, responsive. Available in English, French and Arabic.
landing.step1Desc: Environmental sensors connected to an STE2 Lite gateway. Temperature, humidity, smoke, motion, flood: expandable based on your needs.
landing.step2Desc: A dedicated Python service polls the gateway at regular intervals and stores readings.
landing.step3Desc: The alert engine evaluates each reading against your thresholds. Instant notification on breach.
landing.step4Desc: View your server room status in real time. History, trends, alert management.
landing.hardwareDesc: The HWg STE2 Lite gateway and a Raspberry Pi form the core system, installed in your server room. No open ports on the external network.
landing.hardwareGatewayDesc: 1-Wire sensor reading, static ethernet, zero local storage, read-only polling.
landing.hardwarePiDesc: ARM64 edge computing, 1 GB RAM. Runs the API, database, collector and Cloudflare tunnel.
landing.hardwareSensorDesc: Any 1-Wire sensor type: temperature, humidity, smoke, motion, flood, pressure. Expandable and configurable to your needs.
landing.hardwareTunnelDesc: Zero open ports on the network. TLS outbound tunnel for secure access. Key-only SSH connection.
landing.alertingDesc: Configurable per-sensor rules, customizable thresholds, anti-spike confirmation window, anti-spam cooldown. Choose your notification channels.
landing.alertingRuleDesc: GT, GTE, LT, LTE conditions. Threshold, severity (INFO to EMERGENCY), confirmation window and cooldown configurable.
landing.alertingChannelsDesc: WhatsApp, SMS and Email. A failing channel does not block others. Per-company configurable recipients.
landing.alertingLifecycleDesc: Active, Acknowledged, Resolved. Full searchable history. Acknowledgement from the dashboard.
landing.supportDesc: From hardware installation to alert threshold configuration, our team accompanies you every step of the way. Critical infrastructure, priority support.
landing.supportOnsiteDesc: Gateway and sensor deployment and wiring in your server room by our technicians.
landing.supportConfigDesc: Alert thresholds, notification channels, collection interval: everything is set to your needs.
landing.supportTrainingDesc: Dashboard walkthrough, alert management, data interpretation and routine maintenance.
landing.supportMaintenanceDesc: Software updates, platform monitoring, priority technical support included.
landing.ctaDesc: Contact our team for a free server room diagnostic and a platform demonstration.
landing.productFor: For companies hosting their own infrastructure
landing.productForDesc: You run a server room and need to ensure its availability. El-Haress alerts you before a critical condition damages your equipment. Turnkey solution, deployed on site.
landing.whyDesc: Not an MVP. Not a hobby project. El-Haress is deployed at enterprise clients and monitors real server rooms. Every component is designed for reliability, security and maintainability.
landing.address: IIot No 347, Av. Moktar Ould Daddah, Nouakchott, Mauritania
